lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; f1040s1a (2025), line 36a: "If you have a valid social security number (see instructions) and were born before January 2, 1961, enter the amount from line 35", with the spouse on line 36b; i1040gi p. 33, Line 12d, separates the boxes for you and for your spouse. sa.age65 is the published question "Were you born before January 2, 1961?" for you alone (its consumer is Schedule 1-A line 36a); the candidate reads it as whether any line 12d box (age or blindness, yours or a joint spouse's) is checked. The 17 completed-return value differences (project false, candidate true) are returns where you were not born before January 2, 1961 but your joint spouse was, or (classm.tcw.16) your spouse is blind: classm.f8962.5.deepseek (spouse age 65 or older, you not), classm.f8962.5.gpt, classm.scveh.1, classm.tcw.16, mutation.t2.f8962_months_asset3, generated returns 208, 254, 255, 290, 366, 373, 395 and 476, and four partial records of classm.f8962.5.gpt (sa.spouse_extra, sa.spouse_itemizes, sa.elect_itemize or sa.gambling_losses withheld).
